tei:div.tei:p: dge legs ma bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti pra dza bhyaḥ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /dam chos rgyal po'i dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /rab dga'i ye shes snying po'i don gsal mdzad/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos kun lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin mchog /rgyal ba'i snying po'i mnyam nyid mngon gyur pa/ /mtshungs bral bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun gyi gtso/ /dga' chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' dag 'gro rnams byang chub snying por 'god/ khams gsum dbang phyug khyed la gsol 'debs/ / gang khyod mkhyen brtse nus kun dpag yas kyis/ /rab dga' rigs ldan ma lus zil gyis mnan/ /srid zhi'i snying po yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sku/ /sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum ngo bo rdo rje slob dpon khyed/ /bslab gsum rnam dag pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs/ /sku gsum rang bzhin stobs bcu dbang bsgyur ba/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ /gsung bzhin sgrub dang dgongs pa ji bzhin skyongs/ /rtag tu dgyes byed nam yang rjes 'dzin shog /gzhan yang 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor dbang thang rgyas/ /bsam pa'i don kun gegs med lhun gyis grub/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid dang mtshungs par shog / ces tā ra nā thas rang la bstod pa 'di ni/ sa skyong dbang phyug gzhon nu kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i gsung gis bskul nas nges par brjod pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 6 -- PAGE 1 -- PAGE 5 -
